response.text: I can’t run in the background or send you a later message. If you tell me the task now, I can do it (or produce what you need) during this session. If it truly requires hours of unattended processing, say what it is and I’ll either (a) give a runnable plan or files you can run locally/on a server, or (b) break it into chunks we can do here step‑by‑step. What would you like me to work on?
